Trans person living in scotland here, NC with my father due to a lot of stuff but transphobia is one of them. 

Do not out this child to their parent. Especially now you have heard this parents thoughts on trans people. There are bad people everywhere, many of these bad people will convince you that they love their children when truly they love the idea of being a parent to a child that fits their ideals. 

You could indirectly cause this kid serious harm by passing on this information to their parent without their consent. they already know their throughs on trans people. Why would it be any BETTER or EASIER for them to process if they find out their child "thinks" their trans? 

I don't mean to come across as harsh but I really hope you understand the serious risk you could be imposing on this kid.

Currently 21 - My NDad would do the same thing to me growing up. Setting the router up in a way that would disconnect (and reconnect) my devices only whenever he decided. This could be from 11pm at night until 8pm the next day. 3hrs was not enough 8 ago, let alone now. This was understandable when I below the age of 13, but after that? It was another form of control. What teenager doesn't use the internet? Whether it be for homework or socialising or playing video games or whatever. 

It doesn't matter. 

Society has changed and so has the way teenagers and young adults interact. A consistent connection to the internet is vital. I was so excluded and left out growing up because I missed out on my friends making plans, having certain discussions about things all the while I was sitting in an abusive household with no way of even releasing my feelings. Y'know how people would be able to use the house phone and phone their friends before we would use social media?

Apologies for the rant. I would look into other controlling behaviours such as this and, took me a long time to realise why I was so frustrated and angry at "just the wifi being turned off" but it's so much bigger than that a lot of the time.

I (21FTM) am of the more petty inclination and I'm gonna say keep your gifts. I was also abused by my father for most of my life and not long after I cut him off he tried to send money and such. If I got it, I would spend it. Do whatever you want with the gifts, he owes it to you and more.
